exclusions: Paper's preregistered exclusions: (a) PhD in psychology (phd == 1), (b) not understanding >50% of descriptions, (c) failing the bogus attention-check item 28 (must answer 'no' with confidence 70-80), (d) familiar with the replication projects (knowledge != 5). Only respondents who answered all 28 pages are kept (the paper's N=257 before exclusions). 'I don't understand' ticks are kept as not_understood flags (evaluate drops those answers).
